Check that the sunroof is not damaged.

Position the sunroof on the guides.

The guides must be in the closed position.

Screw on, without tightening, the bolts securing the sunroof, working from the holes underneath. Front the top of the roof, check that the sunroof is positioned correctly in its seating, then tighten the bolts.

The bolts securing the sunroof are treated with locking compound. If they are unscrewed and screwed a few times, they deteriorate and must be replaced with bolts of identical characteristics.

Position the bottom cover and secure with the bolts.

Check that the sunroof is working properly.

Position the ceiling trim.

Fit the retainers.

Fit the seals of the 4 door frames near the ceiling trim.

Fit the cover on the central rear seat belt.

Tighten the cover bolts.
